capture.description: The observed turn's record, copied when the evidence was captured: what a reproduction rebuilds the request from.

AnalysisRecordV1.description: The compact analysis record listed by `eval::list`; evidence and model outputs live separately in the analysis assets.

code_root.description: Frozen at admission with the model: the directory the investigation reads and runs in, absent when code access was off.

harness_version.description: The Harness version the engine reported when a live event admitted the analysis (the turn just ended on it); absent on a manual analysis, which may be of an older session, and when the engine did not say.

model.description: Frozen at admission: later configuration changes never alter it.

observe_since.description: Earlier root turns join the window only if they started after this instant: the monitor was observing then. Turns from before the monitor was enabled are never reported as new.

pending_reason.description: Why collection is still waiting (descendants running, metrics incomplete).

signals.description: Occurrences of each deterministic pattern the collection found, keyed `<rule_id>:<target>` (a target may itself contain colons). Empty both when nothing was found and before collection (`coverage` is set once collection read the evidence).

source_title.description: The session's title, once collection has read it.

stages.description: When each status began, oldest first.

supersedes.description: The earlier analysis of the same turn this reanalysis was requested over (same `observation_key`); absent on a first analysis.

usage.description: The monitor's own consumption, apart from the observed task.

ChangeEditV1.description: One edit of what the model saw. `target` is an entry id of the conversation before the decision point, or `system_prompt`. An edit either replaces `find` with `replace` in the target's text or removes the entry.

CodeRefV1.description: Lines of one file of the code directory.

line_to.description: Last line, inclusive; at most the file's line count.

path.description: Relative to the code directory, e.g. `harness/src/registry.rs` or `context-manager/src/prune.rs`; never absolute and never with `..`.

ComparabilityV1.description: The conditions that must match for a fair comparison; only the Harness version is meant to differ.

ContextSnapshotV1.description: One generation's context accounting. `free = usable - total`, floored at zero: once provider usage lands, `total` is what was billed, which can exceed the `usable` budget the window was fit into — that budget was derived before the generation from an estimate.

compacted.description: The context carries a conversation summary: compacted on this step, or anchored on an earlier compaction entry (a previous step, the console's `/compact`). The summary's tokens count in `system_prompt`.

estimator.description: Which estimator produced the numbers (`heuristic` until the context-manager resolves a real tokenizer). Absent when the context-manager predates the breakdown response.

prefix_divergences.description: Already-sent rows this session's requests rewrote, newest last (at most [`MAX_PREFIX_DIVERGENCES`]), carried from step to step.

prompt_sections_fallback.description: Why no shared prefix went out: `disabled` (config), `no_stable_prefix` (empty identity prompt) or `prefix_rewritten` (a pre_generate hook replaced the prompt head; its prompt still wins, it just shares nothing).

prompt_surface_digest.description: Identity of the shared prompt prefix this generation went out with (`sha256:` of the stable section) — present only when the request carried `system_sections`. A local identity, never a provider hit; `usage.cache_read` is the reuse signal.

session_cost_usd.description: Running cost of the whole session in USD, accumulated across every generation step. `usage.cost_usd` is one step's bill — on providers with steep cache discounts the per-step number swings two orders of magnitude, so a chip showing it alone reads as a bouncing total.

summarized_head_tokens.description: Size of the history that summary replaced.

total.description: Final request estimate: categories plus post-assembly growth.

usable.description: The input budget the window was fit into.

usage.description: Actual provider usage for this generation, stamped after the terminal frame; absent when the provider returned none (or the generation never completed).

oneOf.description: A `registry-changed` notice reached the model between the sources and the repeated call. Temporal correlation, not a proven cause.
Every in-scope transcript was read and the model context holds every diagnostic's evidence.
Previews omit or shorten entries; the full transcripts were read.
Required evidence did not fit; no conclusion of healthy behavior.

diagnostics_in_context.description: Diagnostics shown to the models; all of them stay in the snapshot.

CriterionMetricV1.description: What a validation measures. Every metric but `signal_per_run` is the mean over the runs of the scenario the infrastructure did not break (`pass_rate` is the share that passed, an unfinished run counting as not passed; `duration` is the wall time in milliseconds).

oneOf.description: Occurrences of one of the suggestion's patterns per run, counted by the deterministic detectors over each run's transcript.

scenario_id.description: The scenario whose runs are measured.

DiagnosticV1.description: One deterministic observation. Model judgments never remove it.

evidence.description: Calls, results and notices, in transcript order.

fingerprint.description: Rule, session, turn and the call ids of this occurrence.

reports_available.description: True only when the execution reported retained reports.

started_at.description: When the E2E started the execution (ms since the Unix epoch): its results cannot have existed before.

samples.description: Runs that reported this measure; fewer than `run_count` means some runs reported nothing (never counted as zero).

E2eScenarioV1.description: One scenario's identity and the execution's own averages, as the E2E computed them.

cost_usd_per_run.description: The cohort's total cost divided by its completed runs; the total also covers failed attempts.

mean_score.description: Mean score of the scored runs (0 to 100).

pass_rate.description:
The scenario's cohort in `plan_execution.measurements.cohorts[]`, when the execution has exactly one for it. Each value below is absent when the E2E did not report it, never zero.

Share of the planned runs that passed (0 to 1).

total_tokens_per_run.description: The cohort's total tokens divided by its completed runs.

EntryRefV1.description: A transcript entry, addressed the way `session::messages` returns it.

reviews.description: One row per suggestion, in suggestion order: what people decided about it. A suggestion nobody acted on reads as `new`.

EvidenceRunV1.description: One run of the scenario as the E2E reported it. Runs the infrastructure broke are listed with the E2E's own words, never counted.

completed.description: The E2E reported the run complete with a valid technical outcome.

signals.description: Occurrences of each of the row's patterns the detectors found in this run's transcript (0 is a measurement); absent when the report held no transcript.

technical.description: `technical` as the E2E reported it; anything but `valid` is an infrastructure failure.

mean.description: Mean of the criterion's metric over those runs; absent without a criterion or without such runs.

n.description: Measurable runs (see `EvidenceRunV1::measurable`) with a value of the criterion's metric (every measurable run while there is no criterion).

runs.description: Every run of the scenario the execution holds.

EvidenceV1.description: Computed in code from the attached pair's runs, never by a model. It is what the person's verdict is shown next to.

FailureV1.description: The stage that failed and why. `stage` is the status the analysis was in.

oneOf.description: The provider counts the rebuilt request like the original, up to a fixed per-request overhead measured at the turn's first step.

FidelityV1.description: How faithfully the request at the decision point was rebuilt.

estimator.description: `provider` when the provider counted, else the estimator's name.

off_ratio.description: The unexplained difference over the recorded tokens.

reasons.description: Why the rebuild is approximate; empty when exact.

recorded_tokens.description: Input tokens of the original step: input + cache read + cache write.

InvestigationV1.description: The investigation and its own consumption, kept apart from the observed task's metrics.

code_root.description: The directory the analyst read and ran in; absent when access was off.

JudgeCallV1.description: A Jev call started by this analysis. Persisted before the call so a restart can tell a lost answer from one never requested.

LifecycleEventV1.description: One change of status, with who made it.

LifecycleStatusV1.description: Where a suggestion stands. Only people move it: the monitor never does.

duplicate_of.description: What it duplicates: a pull request, or another `<evaluation_id>:<index>` (`duplicate`).

history.description: Every change of status, oldest first; empty while `new`.

pr.description: The pull request that implements it (`in_progress`, `shipped`).

version.description: The Harness version that shipped it, a semantic version like `1.8.43`; the recurrence query splits the analyses at it.

oneOf.description: Cumulative over the root and every descendant, all turns.

MonitorModelV1.description: The Harness model the user chose for investigations. Credentials stay in the provider worker; this request never carries a key.

provider_options.description: Provider-native options, namespaced by the selected provider id.

MonitorUsageV1.description: Known usage only: absent counters are unknown, never zero.

judge_usage_complete.description: False when Jev reported incomplete usage or failed.

PrefixDivergenceV1.description: One generation that rewrote a row an earlier request of the session had already sent: a prefix-matching provider cache (DeepSeek) stops reusing at that row.

cache_read.description: `usage.cache_read` of the rewriting request: what the provider still reused.

cause.description: What rewrote the row, as far as the harness can tell: `prune` (context-manager pruned or reduced function results to fit the budget that step) or `system_prompt` (row 0: a compaction summary or a prompt change).

index.description: First row (0 = system prompt, then one per message) that differs from the session's previous request. Absent when only the provider's wire mapping changed.

provider_note.description: The provider's own wire-level finding, cause included, when it reported one (a final-message warning starting with [`PROVIDER_PREFIX_NOTE`]).

ReplyCallV1.description: One function call of a reply.

payload.description: The payload as JSON text, cut at 600 characters.

ReplyV1.description: One reply at the decision point: a sample, or the original step read the same way.

signal.description: Whether the signal shows in this reply; null when Jev answered unclear, the reply failed or it was not classified yet.

thinking.description: The opening of the reply's reasoning and of its text, 400 characters each.

oneOf.description: The context as the model saw it.
The suggestion's own `check.change`.
Edits a person wrote.

ReproductionV1.description: A replay of the decision point: N replies sampled from the rebuilt request, with or without a change. No function ever runs.

check.description: The decision point and signal this replay used.

cost_unknown_samples.description: Samples that answered without reporting a cost: unknown, not in `cost_usd`, and never estimated.

cost_usd.description: Known cost of the samples; null while no reply reported one. Only a lower bound while `cost_unknown_samples` is above zero. Jev's calls are in tokens below, never priced.

original.description: The original reply at the decision point, read the same way.

oneOf.description: Legacy: no longer produced; kept so stored records still deserialize.
Legacy: no longer produced.
Legacy: no longer produced.
Legacy: no longer produced.
Legacy: no longer produced.
Legacy: no longer produced.

ScoreLevel.description: Score levels require a description. Unlike instructions, Choice option descriptions and Noul criteria, the provider rejects a null level (HTTP422).

in_scope.description: Out-of-scope descendants belong to earlier turns and are not read.

json_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the collected JSON entries (not of the stored bytes).

preview.description: Masked, shortened entries shown to the models.

reduced_entries.description: Preview entries whose strings were truncated or whose secrets were masked.

traces.description: Trace/span aggregates when the engine's in-memory observability exporter is available. Usage metrics remain available when it is not.

duration_ms.description: Elapsed window from the first observed span to the last observed span.

trace_count.description: Distinct traces across the root session and all descendants.

duration_ms.description: Elapsed window from the session's first observed span to its last.

cache_read_tokens.description: Summed over every generation that reported it. A single generation without the counter (a stream the provider cut before usage came back) is left out of the sum. `null` means no generation reported it or more than one did not — never a measured zero, so the key is always present and a reader can tell the two apart.

cache_write_tokens.description: Summed over every generation that reported it. A single generation without the counter (a stream the provider cut before usage came back) is left out of the sum. `null` means no generation reported it or more than one did not — never a measured zero, so the key is always present and a reader can tell the two apart.

cost_usd.description: Summed over every generation that reported it. context.description: The session's latest per-generation context snapshot (categories, budget, usage) — absent for sessions that have not generated since snapshots landed.

fingerprint.description: The `fingerprint` of a diagnostic in the evidence.

oneOf.description: The reply asks `engine::functions::info` only for contracts an earlier result in the context already supplied.
The reply repeats the last call that failed: same target, equal payload.

SignalV1.description: How to recognize the behavior in one reply: exactly one of a rule computed in code or a yes/no question Jev answers about the reply.

SnapshotCategoriesV1.description: Where the request's tokens sit. Categories are assembly-time estimates; `hook_guidance` is the measured growth after assembly (pre-generate hook appends and orphan-repair patches), 0 when the request left assembly unchanged.

overhead.description: Provider framing plus response_format / provider_options fields.

skills.description: Selected skill bodies contained in the system prompt.

system_prompt.description: Final assembled system prompt excluding tokens attributed to `skills`: identity, per-step aids, and any compaction summary section.

tools.description: Function schemas exposed to the model.

SnapshotMessagesV1.description: Estimated tokens of the assembled window's messages, by role.

e2e_scenario.description: The harness-e2e scenario the observed session ran, when it came from the E2E (`metadata.e2e_scenario`).

excluded_probes.description: Protocol probes that failed as expected and were not reported.

window_turn_ids.description: The observed turn plus earlier root turns no analysis covered yet.

Stats.description: Known accepted usage, never a billing estimate. Unreported counters or failure/cancellation make usage_complete false.

SuggestionCheckV1.description: How a suggestion is checked at the step where its behavior happened.

change.description: The proposed change as edits of what the model saw before that step; empty when it cannot be expressed as text.

decision_point.description: The assistant entry where the behavior happened (`…_<step>_assistant`), one of the suggestion's `evidence` entries.

SuggestionReviewV1.description: Everything people decided about one suggestion, in the `eval_suggestion` state scope. The title, component and patterns are copied from the suggestion so the row outlives the analysis's retention.

first_run_at.description: When the first execution this worker started for the suggestion began, kept when a new start replaces `run`: results of it may have been seen.

patterns.description: `<rule_id>:<target>` of the diagnostics the suggestion's evidence cites: what a validation counts and a release is judged by.

reproductions.description: Replays of the decision point, oldest first: the base and the tested changes.

scenario_id.description: The scenario the suggestion's validation plan names.

check.description: How to reproduce the behavior at the step where it happened, and the proposed change as edits of what the model saw there.

code_refs.description: Code the suggestion rests on, as read in the code directory; only with code access. At most 8; each is checked against the directory.

stats.description: Known usage of the failed call, when the provider returned it.

model.description: The model the provider reports, not the configured default.

TurnCaptureV1.description: The observed turn's record as the Harness stored it, which keeps only a session's latest turn.

hook_guidance_tokens.description: Tokens `pre_generate` hooks added at the turn's last step: above zero, the system prompt the model saw is not stored anywhere.

record.description: The whole `TurnRecord` as read when the evidence was captured (it repeats `options`): what a later fork of the session needs, since the Harness overwrites it with the next turn. Absent when it would have taken the assets over their size limit (`record_omitted` says so) and on analyses made before it was kept.

TurnStatus.description: The coarse, harness-internal turn lifecycle (harness.md § API Reference). Finer-grained than the session's `status`, which the loop derives from it.

ValidationLinkV1.description: Baseline and candidate executions linked to one suggestion. A link is a reference, not a verdict: the improvement claim belongs to the E2E comparison and its criteria.

oneOf.description: The candidate moved the metric by at least `min_effect` in the wanted direction, with `min_runs` completed runs each side.
The metric moved less than `min_effect`.
The metric moved by at least `min_effect` the wrong way.
Too few completed runs, missing data or no criterion.

ValidationPlanV1.description: The E2E plan a suggestion must carry. A reviewer can run it without the LLM that wrote it.

invariants.description: Task-correctness invariants checked by an independent evaluator.

primary_metric.description: The effort metric compared between baseline and candidate.

scenario_id.description: An existing harness-e2e scenario, or null when a new case is needed.

oneOf.description: Recorded before the executions are requested.
Both executions were requested; the sweep waits for them.
Both ended; the pair is about to be attached.
The pair is attached to the analysis and its evidence computed.

ValidationRunV1.description: The baseline and candidate E2E executions this worker started for a suggestion (`eval::start-validation`).

baseline_commit.description: The full commits the Harness was built from.

baseline_execution_id.description: Absent until the E2E accepted the execution.

error.description: Why it failed, or why attaching is being retried; starts with a stable code (`e2e_unavailable:`, `e2e_busy:`…).

finished_at.description: When both executions were seen ended; the sweep stops trying to attach the pair some time after.

VerdictV1.description: The person's judgment, kept with the criterion it was made against.

controls_checked.description: The non-regression controls of the plan that were checked.
